top_signals.title: Gold Pushes Higher as Weaker Dollar Offsets Inflation Risks
top_signals.summary: Gold rose, snapping a three-day decline, as a weakening dollar offset inflation concerns stemming from renewed attacks on ships in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Silver Lake merges Cegid and Silae in €10 billion bet on AI-era software
top_signals.summary: French firms Cegid, which sells business management software, and Silae, a payroll and HR platform, are set to combine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Probe follows TV footage of Nigel Farage’s aides allegedly seeking illegal overseas funding
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Indian conglomerate seeks opportunities of ‘size and relevance’ after US justice department drops charges against billionaire chair Gautam Adani

top_signals.title: Met Police investigates Reform UK over potential breach of electoral law
top_signals.summary: The Metropolitan Police has launched a formal criminal investigation into Reform UK over potentially illegal foreign donations after top party officials were filmed facilitating the acceptance of payments via a middle man.  Detectives will look into the party’s funding following the undercover sting operation by Channel 4 News.   The police were called to act by [...]
